crossRefs.note: I broke the jaws of the unrighteous and plucked the prey out of his teeth.
Arise, Yahweh! Save me, my God! For you have struck all of my enemies on the cheek bone. You have broken the teeth of…
My soul is among lions. I lie among those who are set on fire, even the sons of men, whose teeth are spears and arrows…
Break their teeth, God, in their mouth. Break out the great teeth of the young lions, Yahweh.
There is a generation whose teeth are like swords, and their jaws like knives, to devour the poor from the earth, and…

translations.web: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, the teeth of the young lions, are broken.
translations.bsb: The lion may roar, and the fierce lion may growl, yet the teeth of the young lions are broken.
translations.kjv: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, and the teeth of the young lions, are broken.
translations.asv: The roaring of the lion, and the voice of the fierce lion, And the teeth of the young lions, are broken.
